name: Dagon
source:
Dagon is a free 3D narrative experience in madness (you could also call it a daemonic visual novel) based on the cult short story of the same title by the master of cosmic horror, H. P. Lovecraft himself. It’s an interactive portal into the world of the controversial genius and his highly acclaimed Cthulhu Mythos, open to both newcomers and long-time devotees.

Step into the shoes of a former ship officer and morphine fiend, and dive into the Stygian Abyss of a drug-addled mind. Uncover the unspeakable, long-drowned horrors on a distant eldritch island and wallow in Lovecraftian dread.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1481400/Dagon/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《達貢》是一段免費的3D敘事體驗，帶你走入瘋狂之中，你也可以將其稱為一部充滿魔性的視覺小說。作品改編自宇宙恐怖大師H.P.洛夫克拉夫特親筆創作、深受書迷推崇的同名短篇小說。它是一道互動式入口，讓初次接觸的玩家與資深愛好者，都能走進這位備受爭議的天才及其廣受讚譽的克蘇魯神話世界。

你將化身一名沉迷嗎啡的前船舶高階船員，潛入被藥物擾亂的心智深處，那漆黑如冥河的深淵。在遙遠而詭異的孤島上，揭開那些早已沉沒、無法言說的恐怖，沉浸於洛夫克拉夫特式的驚懼之中。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1481400/Dagon/]Steam[/url]]
